t: The OB1 Multi Surface Sealant and Adhesive is a versatile hybrid polymer formulation designed for superior bonding and sealing across numerous applications. This solvent-free solution offers exceptional performance, ensuring it never cracks or shrinks, making it a reliable choice for professionals. It is ideal for various trade applications, including plumbing, general construction, and repairs in damp environments, as it can be applied on wet surfaces and even underwater. With very high bond strength and resistance to fungal and bacterial growth, this low odour sealant adheres perfectly without primer on most surfaces, providing a durable and paintable finish.
